title: LinkedProjectToProcessSummary
description: A row of the DynamoDB channel_project_link table as process-summary reads it: the response to linked_project_to_db_channel_project_link. A channel with no link has no row.

channel_id.description: The table's key: the Slack channel.

project_id.description: The linked GitHub Project's node ID.

last_summary_at.description: ISO 8601 time in UTC when a summary was last received; absent before the first.
